description: Read one named signal. Permitted signals return their bounded latest payload; China-economic signals in the denied lineage closure return explicit restricted/unavailable rights metadata and no values. Call list_signals first to discover valid names. Use this for the AI-model-evaluation side too: 'eval-registry' returns the pre-registered, hash-chained eval ledger with its verified flag and Merkle root, 'gfi-transcripts' returns a bounded view of the complete GFI v2 response matrix, and 'refusal-drift' returns the current frontier-model refusal reading on the frozen benign probe set; read 'eval-assurance' before turning either into a validity claim, and 'eval-journal' for the evidence-bound explanation and source receipts, or 'eval-findings' for the current deterministic article edition. Distinct from gfw_reading, which merges the two Great Firewall layers into one combined view.

max_rows.description: cap on long row arrays (dataset, ranked, samples). Default 25 keeps a call small enough not to stall a tool loop; the generative-firewall-index dataset is 132 rows. Any cap applied is reported in the response with the true total, never silently.

name.description: signal name from list_signals, e.g. 'ooni-gfw', 'eval-registry', 'eval-assurance', 'eval-journal', 'eval-findings', 'gfi-transcripts' or 'refusal-drift'

name: get_signal
title: One signal's full reading
